summary.text: In May 2026, Michael advocated integrating AI into military decision-making, intelligence analysis, and departmental operations. In September 2026, he endorsed engineering solutions to AI safety concerns and predicted that new industries would emerge around superintelligence. In October 2026, he described his Super Intelligence Force role as helping secure American leadership and ensuring the technology serves all Americans.

kids_chatbots.why: No statement on limits on AI chatbots for minors.

deepfakes.why: No statement on penalties for harmful deepfakes or likeness rights.

election_ads.why: No statement on deceptive AI in election ads.

labeling.why: No statement on labeling or watermarking AI content.

dc_moratorium.why: No statement on pausing data center construction.

dc_ratepayers.why: No statement on data centers paying power costs.

layoff_reporting.why: No statement on reporting AI-caused layoffs.

bias_audits.why: No statement on bias audits or discriminatory AI.

training_consent.why: No statement on consent or payment for AI training data.

chips.why: Export-control remarks (s7, s8) concern an AI model, not chip or chip-tool export controls.

testing_mandate.why: No statement on mandatory safety testing; general 'red tape' and speed comments do not name testing rules.

transparency.why: No statement on safety plans or incident reporting.

whistleblowers.why: No statement on AI whistleblower protections.

liability.why: No statement on developer liability for AI harms.

misuse.why: No statement on safeguards against AI weapons help.

nuclear.why: No statement on human control of nuclear launch.

autonomous_weapons.why: He seeks partners for autonomous systems (s6) but does not address human-in-the-loop limits or bans on lethal autonomous weapons.

licensing.why: No statement on licensing or a new AI agency; general anti-red-tape remarks do not name these.

intl_agreement.why: No statement on an international AI safety agreement.

pause.why: He urges speed and 'keep building,' but never addresses a pause or slowdown on frontier AI development.

rsi.why: No statement on limits on self-improving AI or automated research.

preemption.why: Concern about local rules slowing companies and a preference for congressional action do not establish support for overriding state AI laws.

superintelligence.why: Encouragement to build a superintelligence ecosystem does not establish a position on a ban; no supplied statement explicitly rejects or supports such a ban.
